scope_note: Agent review on 2026-10-16 inspected fresh main and recent merges, repository structure/instructions, schemas, active task/claim state, source and media records, existing tests and validation/CI commands. Ground-truth restrictions are explicitly annotation inference, not measured diagnostic sensitivity or localization evidence. Existing whole-plant/paired-surface/serial context retained. One profile and one existing citation enriched; no new source identities, media, binaries, licenses, labels or training admissions. Three unknown-rights institutional references remain hidden, license-review flagged and not permitted for training; photo-only cap stays 0.15. Fresh full run passed type check, all 291 application tests, build and all 62 validators; full Python discovery passed 103 tests. Frozen byte hashes and git diff check passed; exports and model-data hash pins synchronized. PHP unavailable locally; hosted lint required before integration. Frozen 191 text rows do not imply an executed training run. Verification-before-completion gated publication. Local operational task claim retained through integration and released after merge without publishing it. Remaining gaps: rights-cleared Cannabis symptom/video series, leaf-level assay localization, independent mixed-infection samples and healthy controls, and broader cultivar/site replication. Band-only, case-unlinked or leaf-unlocalized labels retain human-review flags. Agent review is not human or laboratory sample confirmation.
